detail:
Decisions: Accepted implementer's deviation from the plan's http-server.ts wiring snippet: `handled ? true : apiHandler(req,res)` instead of `handled ? undefined : ...` — the plan's literal snippet drops the handled=true signal and triggers a spurious static-file fallback after every successful query route; reviewer instructed to verify both short-circuit and fallback behaviors.
Findings: Contract note for the upcoming client index store: DecisionStatus includes 'archived', so /api/index total_counts.decisions can carry a 5th key beyond active/provisional/superseded/overridden — client count comparison must iterate all keys generically.; Contract note: /api/index blackboard rows omit the tags key entirely when tags are empty (not tags: []) — client must treat tags as optional.
summary: Task 2 (/api/index endpoint) implemented via subagent, TDD green (6 new tests, full suite 1120 pass, tsc clean); review subagent running. Task 1 committed as 262ce0f after approved review.
